statement: When a specimen is a repository-shaped tree, make its pin kind explicit and validate the kind against the committed object. Digest a deterministic recursive manifest containing mode, type, object id, and relative path with SHA-256; a tree object id is not a content digest. Exercise valid blob and tree controls, nested edits, additions, removals, mode changes, kind mismatches, missing declarations, and working-tree divergence so a passing pin constrains the committed specimen rather than merely existing.

movesWhen.reason: Await operator review and merge of the Card 16 evidence-pin tree-object proposal.
